te: Among the worst of people in rank before Allah on the Day of Resurrection is the man who is intimate with his wife and she with him, and then he spreads her secret.
n_ar: أسرار البيت والعلاقة الزوجية أمانة؛ فضحها بعد الخلاف أو في المزاح خيانة لا تُبرَّر.
n_en: The private life of a marriage is a trust; exposing it, even in anger or jest, is a betrayal.

te: Four traits, whoever has them all is a pure hypocrite, and whoever has one of them has a trait of hypocrisy until he leaves it: when trusted he betrays, when he speaks he lies, when he makes a pact he breaks it, and when he quarrels he is outrageous.
n_ar: ميزان عملي لتقييم أي علاقة أو شراكة: الأمانة، والصدق، والوفاء، والإنصاف وقت الخصومة.
n_en: A practical test for any relationship or partnership: trust, truthfulness, loyalty, and fairness in a dispute.

te: Guard yourselves from the Fire, even with half a date; and whoever cannot find it, then with a good word.
n_ar: لا تحتقر القليل الذي تملكه؛ نصف تمرة أو كلمة طيبة قد تكون كل ما يحتاجه إنسان اليوم.
n_en: Do not belittle the little you have: half a date, or a kind word, may be all someone needs today.

te: The rights of a Muslim over a Muslim are five: returning the greeting, visiting the sick, following funerals, accepting invitations, and responding to one who sneezes.
n_ar: حقوق صغيرة تبني العلاقات: سلام وزيارة مريض ومشاركة في العزاء؛ وغيابها هو ما يشعر به الناس بالجفاء.
n_en: Small duties that build bonds: a greeting, a visit to the sick, presence at a funeral. Their absence is what people feel as coldness.

te: When a Muslim visits his sick brother, he remains in the harvest of Paradise until he returns.
n_ar: زيارة المريض ليست مجاملة؛ هي قطاف من الجنة لك، وأنس كبير له.
n_en: Visiting the sick is not a courtesy: it is a harvest of Paradise for you and great comfort for them.

te: Whoever visits a sick person whose time has not come and says seven times beside him: “I ask Allah the Mighty, Lord of the Mighty Throne, to heal you”, Allah will heal him of that illness.
n_ar: دعاء قصير يُقال عند المريض؛ يجمع بين السعي إلى العلاج والتعلق بالشافي.
n_en: A short supplication said at a sick person's side, joining treatment with reliance on the Healer.

te: O Allah, forgive Abu Salamah, raise his rank among the guided, be the successor to those he left behind, forgive us and him, O Lord of the worlds, make his grave spacious and give him light in it.
n_ar: دعاء النبي ﷺ عند وفاة أبي سلمة؛ يصلح أن تدعو به لمن فقدته، وفيه سؤال الخَلَف لمن بقي بعده.
n_en: The Prophet's prayer when Abu Salamah died; one can pray it for anyone lost, asking also for those left behind.

te: Do you not hear? Allah does not punish for the tears of the eye nor for the grief of the heart, but He punishes or shows mercy because of this (and he pointed to his tongue).
n_ar: البكاء والحزن على الفقيد لا إثم فيهما؛ المحاسبة على ما يقوله اللسان من اعتراض أو سخط.
n_en: Tears and grief over a loss carry no sin; what counts is what the tongue says in protest or resentment.

te: This is a mercy that Allah has placed in the hearts of His servants; and Allah has mercy only on the merciful among His servants.
n_ar: قالها النبي ﷺ وعيناه تدمعان؛ فالدمع عند الفقد رحمة لا ضعف إيمان.
n_en: The Prophet said this with tears in his eyes: weeping at a loss is mercy, not weak faith.

te: O Allah, forgive him, have mercy on him, keep him safe and pardon him; honour his arrival, widen his entry, wash him with water, snow and hail, and cleanse him of sins as a white garment is cleansed of dirt; give him a home better than his home and family better than his family, admit him to Paradise and protect him from the punishment of the grave and of the Fire.
n_ar: من أجمع ما يُدعى به للميت؛ والدعاء له من أعظم البر بعد رحيله.
n_en: One of the fullest prayers for the deceased; praying for them is among the best kindness after they are gone.

te: The believer's soul is held by his debt until it is paid on his behalf.
n_ar: الدين أمر عظيم يتجاوز الحياة؛ فالتخطيط لسداده وتوثيقه من الأمانة لا من القلق.
n_en: Debt reaches beyond this life; planning its repayment and writing it down is responsibility, not anxiety.

te: Act, for everyone is eased toward what he was created for.
n_ar: الإيمان بالقدر لا يعني ترك العمل؛ بل يعني أن تعمل وأنت مطمئن أن الطريق المناسب لك سيتيسّر.
n_en: Belief in decree is no reason to stop acting: act, trusting that the path meant for you will be made easy.

te: When a servant's child dies, Allah says to His angels: “Did you take the child of My servant?” They say yes. He says: “Did you take the fruit of his heart?” They say yes. He says: “What did My servant say?” They say: “He praised You and said ‘To Allah we belong and to Him we return.’” Allah says: “Build for My servant a house in Paradise and name it the House of Praise.”
n_ar: لمن فقد ولده: الله يسمّي ولدك «ثمرة فؤادك»، فهو يعلم مقدار وجعك، ويعدّ لصبرك بيتًا في الجنة.
n_en: For a parent who has lost a child: Allah calls your child “the fruit of your heart”; He knows your pain and prepares a house for your patience.

te: Two words light on the tongue, heavy in the Balance, beloved to the Most Merciful: Glory be to Allah and praise Him; glory be to Allah the Magnificent.
n_ar: بداية سهلة لمن فتر إيمانه: ذكر لا يأخذ ثواني، وأثره ثقيل في الميزان.
n_en: An easy start when faith feels weak: words that take seconds yet weigh heavily.

te: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from miserliness, I seek refuge in You from cowardice, I seek refuge in You from being returned to the most feeble age, I seek refuge in You from the trial of this world (meaning the trial of the Antichrist), and I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave.
n_ar: استعاذة من الجبن والبخل وضعف الكِبَر؛ مفيدة لمن يشعر بالخوف من المواجهة أو من المستقبل.
n_en: Seeking refuge from cowardice, miserliness and frail old age; helpful for fear of confrontation or of the future.

te: Mu‘adh, I advise you never to leave saying after every prayer: “O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You and to worship You well.”
n_ar: علاج للفتور: اطلب العون على الطاعة نفسها، ولا تنتظر أن تجد الهمة وحدك.
n_en: A cure for weak motivation: ask for help with worship itself rather than waiting to feel motivated.

te: O Allah, forgive me all my sins, the small and the great, the first and the last, the open and the secret.
n_ar: لمن أثقلته ذنوب كثيرة لا يحصيها: دعاء يجمعها كلها ويطلب مغفرتها مرة واحدة.
n_en: For someone weighed down by countless sins: a prayer that gathers them all and asks forgiveness for them at once.

te: The likeness of the house in which Allah is remembered and the house in which He is not remembered is that of the living and the dead.
n_ar: البيت الذي يُذكر فيه الله بيت حيّ؛ وذكر قليل يومي يغيّر جو البيت ونفسك.
n_en: A home where Allah is remembered is alive; a little daily remembrance changes the home and the heart.

te: Allah says: “I am as My servant thinks of Me, and I am with him when he remembers Me. If he remembers Me in himself, I remember him in Myself; and if he remembers Me in a gathering, I remember him in a gathering better than it.”
n_ar: حسن الظن بالله علاج لليأس: الله عند ظن عبده به، فلا تُغلق باب الأمل على نفسك.
n_en: Thinking well of Allah is a cure for despair: He is as His servant thinks of Him, so do not shut the door of hope.

te: Keep your tongue moist with the remembrance of Allah.
n_ar: وصية عملية لمن كثرت عليه الأعباء: عبادة خفيفة ترافقك طوال اليوم.
n_en: Practical advice for someone overloaded: a light worship that stays with you all day.

te: No people sit remembering Allah but the angels surround them, mercy covers them, tranquility descends upon them, and Allah mentions them among those with Him.
n_ar: الطمأنينة تنزل على المجالس الطيبة؛ والصحبة الصالحة دواء للوحدة والقلق.
n_en: Tranquility descends on good gatherings; good company is a remedy for loneliness and anxiety.

te: Had you said in the evening, “I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He created”, it would not have harmed you.
n_ar: ذكر قصير للمساء يعطي القلب أمانًا عند الخوف من الأذى.
n_en: A short evening remembrance that gives the heart security when afraid of harm.

te: O Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Lord and Sovereign of all things, I bear witness that there is no god but You; I seek refuge in You from the evil of my own soul and from the evil of Satan and his call to associate others with You.
n_ar: استعاذة من شرّ النفس نفسها؛ تعين من يتعبه حديث داخلي سلبي أو وساوس متكررة.
n_en: Seeking refuge from the evil of one's own self; helps those troubled by negative inner talk or recurring whispers.

te: Recite “Say: He is Allah, One” and the two chapters of refuge in the evening and the morning, three times; they will suffice you against everything.
n_ar: تحصين يومي بسيط لمن يقلقه الحسد أو الأذى أو الوسواس؛ لا يحتاج أكثر من دقيقة.
n_en: A simple daily protection for those worried about envy, harm or intrusive thoughts; it takes a minute.

te: When one of you goes to bed, let him dust off his bed with the inside of his garment, for he does not know what came onto it after him; then let him say: “In Your name, my Lord, I lay down my side and by You I raise it; if You take my soul, have mercy on it, and if You send it back, protect it as You protect Your righteous servants.”
n_ar: دعاء النوم يسلّم النفس لله كل ليلة؛ يخفف قلق الليل والخوف من الموت.
n_en: The bedtime prayer entrusts the soul to Allah each night; it eases night anxiety and fear of death.

te: When you go to bed, perform ablution as for prayer, lie on your right side and say: “O Allah, I submit myself to You, turn my face to You, entrust my affair to You and lean my back on You, in hope and in awe of You; there is no refuge and no escape from You except to You. I believe in Your Book which You revealed and in Your Prophet whom You sent.” If you die, you die upon natural faith; make these your last words.
n_ar: تفويض الأمر لله قبل النوم يُنزل همّ القرارات المعلّقة عن كتفيك بعد أن تفعل ما عليك.
n_en: Entrusting your affairs to Allah before sleep lifts the weight of pending decisions once you have done your part.

te: Praise be to Allah who fed us, gave us drink, sufficed us and sheltered us; how many have none to suffice them and none to shelter them.
n_ar: تذكير يومي بنعم نعدّها عادية؛ والامتنان لها يخفف الشعور بالنقص.
n_en: A daily reminder of blessings we treat as ordinary; gratitude for them eases the feeling of lack.

te: O Allah, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
n_ar: كان أكثر دعاء النبي ﷺ؛ لا تضاد بين طلب خير الدنيا وخير الآخرة.
n_en: The Prophet's most frequent prayer: there is no conflict between asking for good in this life and in the next.

te: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity and self-sufficiency.
n_ar: أربع حاجات تحمي الإنسان: هداية الطريق، والتقوى، والعفة أمام الشهوات، والغنى عن الناس.
n_en: Four needs that protect a person: guidance, piety, chastity before desire, and independence from people.

te: Say: “O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, grant me well-being and provide for me” (and he gathered his fingers except the thumb), for these gather for you your world and your Hereafter.
n_ar: دعاء قصير يجمع حاجات الدنيا والآخرة؛ مناسب لمن تتزاحم عليه الهموم.
n_en: A short prayer gathering the needs of both worlds; suited to someone crowded by worries.

te: O Allah, Turner of hearts, turn our hearts to Your obedience.
n_ar: القلوب تتقلب؛ فالخوف من تغيّر الحال يُعالَج بالدعاء لا بالقلق.
n_en: Hearts change; the fear of one's state changing is met with prayer, not with anxiety.

te: Seek refuge in Allah from the strain of affliction, from being overtaken by misery, from an evil decree, and from the gloating of enemies.
n_ar: استعاذة شاملة من شدة البلاء وسوء العاقبة وشماتة الآخرين؛ تناسب من يمرّ بضغط شديد.
n_en: A comprehensive refuge from severe hardship, bad outcomes and others' gloating; for times of heavy pressure.

te: O Allah, set right for me my religion which is the safeguard of my affairs, set right for me my world in which is my living, set right for me my Hereafter to which is my return; make life an increase for me in every good, and make death a rest for me from every evil.
n_ar: دعاء يطلب صلاح الدين والمعيشة والمآل معًا؛ مفيد عند الحيرة في مسار الحياة.
n_en: A prayer for the soundness of faith, livelihood and final return together; helpful when unsure of life's direction.

te: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from inability and laziness, from cowardice and decrepitude, and from miserliness; I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave and from the trials of life and death.
n_ar: التفريق بين العجز (عدم القدرة) والكسل (عدم الرغبة)؛ والاستعاذة منهما بداية الحركة.
n_en: It distinguishes inability from laziness; seeking refuge from both is the first step to moving.

te: Say: “O Allah, I have wronged myself greatly, and none forgives sins but You; so forgive me with forgiveness from You and have mercy on me; You are the Forgiving, the Merciful.”
n_ar: علّمه النبي ﷺ لأبي بكر؛ فالاعتراف بالتقصير ليس خاصًّا بالعصاة، بل هو حال كل مؤمن.
n_en: Taught to Abu Bakr: admitting one's failings is not only for sinners but the state of every believer.

te: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from laziness and decrepitude, from sin and debt, from the trial of the grave and its punishment, from the trial of the Fire and its punishment, and from the evil of the trial of wealth; and I seek refuge in You from the trial of poverty.
n_ar: للغنى فتنة وللفقر فتنة؛ فالاستعاذة من شر كليهما توازن في النظرة إلى المال.
n_en: Wealth and poverty each have their trial; seeking refuge from the evil of both keeps a balanced view of money.

te: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from bad character, bad deeds and bad desires.
n_ar: لمن يجاهد نفسه في طبع سيئ أو عادة: الدعاء جزء من العلاج لا بديل عنه.
n_en: For someone fighting a bad trait or habit: prayer is part of the treatment, not a substitute for it.

te: Say: “O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of my hearing, the evil of my sight, the evil of my tongue, the evil of my heart and the evil of my desire.”
n_ar: يسمّي منافذ الضعف واحدًا واحدًا؛ مناسب لمن يعالج إدمان المشاهدة أو الشهوة.
n_en: It names each gate of weakness; suited to someone treating an addiction of the eyes or of desire.

te: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from hunger, for it is an evil bedfellow, and I seek refuge in You from betrayal, for it is an evil inner trait.
n_ar: الجوع والخيانة: ضيق العيش وضيق الضمير؛ والاستعاذة منهما معًا لأن الأول قد يدفع إلى الثاني.
n_en: Hunger and betrayal: hardship of living and of conscience; asked together, since the first may push to the second.

te: O ‘Abbas, uncle of the Messenger of Allah, ask Allah for well-being in this world and the Hereafter.
n_ar: العافية من أعظم ما يُسأل؛ والدعاء بها لا يتعارض مع الأخذ بأسباب العلاج.
n_en: Well-being is among the greatest things to ask for; praying for it goes together with seeking treatment.

te: The supplication of a Muslim for his brother in his absence is answered: at his head is an angel; whenever he prays for good for his brother, the angel says: “Amen, and for you the same.”
n_ar: علاج عملي للحسد والضغينة: ادعُ لمن تحسده أو تختلف معه بظهر الغيب، والملَك يدعو لك بمثله.
n_en: A practical cure for envy and grudges: pray in secret for the person, and the angel prays the same for you.

te: Whoever is done a favour and says to the one who did it, “May Allah reward you with good”, has done his utmost in praise.
n_ar: كلمة شكر صادقة تحفظ العلاقات؛ والجحود يبدأ من نسيان قولها.
n_en: A sincere word of thanks keeps relationships alive; ingratitude begins with forgetting to say it.

te: Do not pray against yourselves, do not pray against your children and do not pray against your wealth, lest it coincide with an hour in which Allah is asked and He answers you.
n_ar: لحظة الغضب على الأبناء أو على النفس قد يُقال فيها كلام خطير؛ امسك لسانك وادعُ بالخير بدلًا منه.
n_en: In a moment of anger at children or oneself, dangerous words can be said; hold back and pray for good instead.

te: There is no Muslim on earth who calls upon Allah with a supplication but Allah gives it to him, or turns away from him an equal evil, as long as he does not pray for sin or for cutting ties of kinship.
n_ar: لمن يظن أن دعاءه لا يُستجاب: الإجابة قد تكون عطاءً، أو صرف شرٍّ لا تراه.
n_en: For anyone who feels their prayers go unanswered: the answer may be a gift, or an evil turned away that you never see.

te: Whoever takes a hand-span of land unjustly, it will be hung around his neck from seven earths.
n_ar: الاعتداء على أرض أو ميراث ولو قليلًا ظلم عظيم؛ والحقوق لا تسقط بالسكوت عنها.
n_en: Taking land or inheritance unjustly, even a little, is a grave wrong; rights do not lapse by silence.

te: Whoever guarantees me what is between his jaws and what is between his legs, I guarantee him Paradise.
n_ar: اللسان والشهوة بابان كبيران للخطأ؛ حراستهما هي أقصر طريق إلى السلامة.
n_en: The tongue and desire are the two great gates of error; guarding them is the shortest road to safety.

te: A servant may say a word without thinking about it, and because of it he slips into the Fire further than the distance between the east and the west.
n_ar: قبل أن تكتب أو تنشر: كلمة واحدة بلا تفكير قد تهدم ما لا يُبنى؛ خاصة على مواقع التواصل.
n_en: Before you write or post: one thoughtless word can destroy what cannot be rebuilt, especially online.

te: Say: “My Lord is Allah”, then be steadfast.
n_ar: جملة تختصر الطريق: وضوح الوجهة ثم الثبات عليها يومًا بعد يوم.
n_en: A sentence that sums up the path: a clear direction, then steadiness on it day after day.

te: Hold your tongue, let your home suffice you, and weep over your sins.
n_ar: في أوقات الفتن والخصومات: كفّ اللسان، والالتفات إلى بيتك وإصلاح نفسك.
n_en: In times of strife and quarrels: hold your tongue, turn to your home, and mend yourself.

te: Your blood, your wealth and your honour are sacred to you, like the sanctity of this day of yours, in this month of yours, in this land of yours. Have I not conveyed?
n_ar: كرامة الإنسان وماله وعرضه مقدسة؛ والتعدي على السمعة كالتعدي على المال.
n_en: A person's life, wealth and honour are sacred; attacking someone's reputation is like attacking their property.

te: When I was taken up, I passed by people with nails of copper scratching their faces and chests. I said: “Who are these, Jibril?” He said: “These are those who eat the flesh of people and attack their honour.”
n_ar: صورة شديدة لأثر الغيبة: من يجرح أعراض الناس يجرح نفسه.
n_en: A stark image of backbiting: whoever wounds others' honour ends up wounding himself.

te: Whoever defends the honour of his brother, Allah will turn the Fire away from his face on the Day of Resurrection.
n_ar: إذا سمعت الغيبة في مجلس فالدفاع عن الغائب عبادة، وليس فضولًا أو إحراجًا.
n_en: When you hear backbiting in a gathering, defending the absent person is worship, not meddling.

te: Shall I tell you what al-‘adh is? It is tale-bearing, the talk carried between people.
n_ar: نقل الكلام بين الناس يفسد العلاقات أكثر من الكلام نفسه؛ قطع السلسلة عندك فضيلة.
n_en: Carrying words between people ruins relationships more than the words themselves; stopping the chain with you is a virtue.

te: You will find people like mines; the best of them before Islam are the best in Islam if they understand; and you will find the worst of people to be the two-faced, who comes to these with one face and to those with another.
n_ar: إرضاء الجميع بوجهين يفقدك احترام الجميع؛ الوضوح الهادئ أكرم من المجاملة المزدوجة.
n_en: Pleasing everyone with two faces costs you everyone's respect; calm clarity is nobler than double flattery.

te: Whoever claims a dream he did not see will be made to tie two barley grains together and will not manage; whoever listens to the talk of people who dislike that, molten lead will be poured into his ears on the Day of Resurrection.
n_ar: التجسس على أحاديث الناس ورسائلهم اعتداء على خصوصيتهم ولو بدافع القلق أو الغيرة.
n_en: Eavesdropping on people's talk or messages violates their privacy, even when driven by worry or jealousy.

te: It is enough of a lie for a person to relate everything he hears.
n_ar: قبل إعادة النشر: نقل كل ما يُسمع كذب حتى لو لم تكن أنت من اخترعه.
n_en: Before you share: passing on everything you hear counts as lying even if you did not invent it.

te: The one who pretends to have what he was not given is like one wearing two garments of falsehood.
n_ar: التظاهر بحياة أو إنجاز ليس لك، كما يحدث على مواقع التواصل، زيف يُتعب صاحبه قبل غيره.
n_en: Pretending to a life or success you do not have, as often happens online, is a falsehood that wears out its owner first.

te: It is not fitting for a truthful person to be one who curses much.
n_ar: السبّ واللعن عادة تتسلل وقت الغضب؛ والصادق مع نفسه ينظّف لسانه منها.
n_en: Cursing creeps in during anger; a person true to himself keeps his tongue clean of it.

te: Insulting a Muslim is wickedness, and fighting him is disbelief.
n_ar: الخلاف لا يبرر السباب؛ فالكلمة الجارحة معصية مهما كان الطرف الآخر مخطئًا.
n_en: Disagreement does not justify insults; a wounding word is a sin however wrong the other side is.

te: Do not insult the dead, for they have reached what they sent ahead.
n_ar: بعد الوفاة ينتهي الحساب بين الناس؛ فلا مكان لتصفية الحسابات مع من رحل.
n_en: After death, the accounts between people close; there is no place for settling scores with the departed.

te: Whoever loves to be moved away from the Fire and admitted to Paradise, let death come to him while he believes in Allah and the Last Day, and let him treat people the way he loves to be treated.
n_ar: قاعدة ذهبية للعلاقات والعمل: عامل الناس كما تحب أن يعاملوك.
n_en: A golden rule for relationships and work: treat people as you would love to be treated.

te: Do not hate one another, do not envy one another, do not turn your backs on one another and do not cut ties; be, servants of Allah, brothers. It is not lawful for a Muslim to shun his brother for more than three days.
n_ar: ثلاثة أيام حدّ للهجر بعد الخلاف؛ بعدها يبدأ الإصلاح ولو بالسلام.
n_en: Three days is the limit for shunning after a dispute; after that, repair begins, even if only with a greeting.

te: If you pursue the faults of Muslims, you will corrupt them, or nearly corrupt them.
n_ar: تتبّع الأخطاء والمراقبة الدائمة تفسد العلاقة؛ في البيت والعمل والصداقة.
n_en: Hunting for faults and constant surveillance corrupt relationships, at home, at work and among friends.

te: It is enough evil for a person to look down on his Muslim brother.
n_ar: الاحتقار ليس رأيًا بل شرّ قائم بذاته، مهما كان الفرق في المال أو العلم أو المكانة.
n_en: Contempt is not an opinion but an evil in itself, whatever the gap in wealth, knowledge or status.

te: Why did you not put it on top of the food so people could see it? Whoever cheats is not of us.
n_ar: إخفاء العيب في البيع أو العمل غش، حتى لو لم ينتبه له أحد.
n_en: Hiding a defect in a sale or in work is cheating, even if no one notices.

te: Whoever turns a man's wife against him, or his servant, is not of us.
n_ar: تحريض أحد الزوجين على الآخر، من الأهل أو الأصدقاء، ذنب كبير لا نصيحة.
n_en: Turning a spouse against their partner, whether by family or friends, is a grave sin, not advice.

te: Every betrayer will have a banner on the Day of Resurrection; it will be said: “This is the betrayal of so-and-so.”
n_ar: الغدر قد يخفى في الدنيا، لكنه يُكشف يوم القيامة؛ فلا تحمل همّ أن يفلت الخائن.
n_en: Betrayal may stay hidden in this life but will be exposed on the Day; you need not carry the worry that the betrayer escapes.

te: Allah said: “Three I will be the opponent of on the Day of Resurrection: a man who gave his word by Me and then betrayed it, a man who sold a free person and ate his price, and a man who hired a worker, took full work from him and did not give him his wage.”
n_ar: أكل أجر العامل أو تأخيره ظلم يتولى الله الخصومة فيه بنفسه؛ لمن ظُلم في أجره عزاء، ولمن يوظف تحذير.
n_en: Withholding a worker's wage is a wrong Allah Himself takes up: comfort for the wronged, a warning for employers.

te: When a man says “The people are ruined”, he is the most ruined of them.
n_ar: التعميم المتشائم عن الناس، احتقارًا أو يأسًا، يؤذي صاحبه أولًا.
n_en: Pessimistic generalising about people, out of contempt or despair, harms the speaker first.

te: Satan has despaired of being worshipped by those who pray in the Arabian Peninsula, but not of stirring them up against one another.
n_ar: كثير من الخلافات الزوجية والعائلية تحريش؛ معرفة ذلك تخفف حدة الخصومة.
n_en: Many marital and family quarrels are incitement by Satan; knowing this softens the dispute.

te: When you are three, two should not converse privately apart from the third until you mingle with people, because that would grieve him.
n_ar: مراعاة مشاعر من يشعر بالإقصاء أدب نبوي؛ في المجالس والمجموعات وعلى الإنترنت.
n_en: Caring for someone who may feel left out is prophetic courtesy, in gatherings, groups and online.
